title: 78% Wanted This AI Feature. Almost Nobody Used It - Supriya Subudhi, Bumble

>> Uh my name is Supriya. Uh happy to be

about why AB testing for AI products is
weird.

to evaluate two versions of something
with each other and see which is better.
So, that could be two versions of an
email where you're trying to see which
one's getting more clicks. It could be
two versions of a feature. It could just
be a feature against what's already live

and already know that uh when it comes

LLMs in consumer tech features,
a positive result from an AB test is

reasons that I've specifically
